title: Loops: rows, floors and cubes
reflection: How many lines would the cube take without loops? What would you change in your program to build a cube 10 blocks wide?

steps.goal: Write a program that builds a straight row of 10 blocks, using a for loop.
steps.block_goal: Write a program that builds a straight row of 10 blocks, using a repeat block.
steps.not_yet: Not yet: build a straight row of 10 blocks, one block high.
hints: byte.placeDown() puts a block under Byte, so first go up one block with byte.up(). MINE has already put the blocks in the highlighted slot.
for i = 1, 10 do ... end repeats what is inside 10 times. Inside the loop: place a block below, then move forward.
block_hints: The "place a block below" block puts a block under Byte, so first "move up". MINE has already put the blocks in the highlighted slot.
"repeat 10 times" repeats the blocks inside it. Inside: "place a block below", then "move forward".

steps.goal: Build a solid floor 5 blocks long and 4 blocks wide. How many blocks does it take?
steps.not_yet: Not yet: build a solid floor, 5 blocks long and 4 wide, one block thick.
hints: A floor is 4 rows of 5 blocks: put the loop for one row inside another loop. How many blocks does it take? Area = 5 × 4 = 20.
After each row: go back to the start of the row with byte.back() 5 times (another loop), then turn right, move forward one block and turn left.
block_hints: A floor is 4 rows of 5 blocks: put the "repeat" of one row inside another "repeat". How many blocks does it take? Area = 5 × 4 = 20.
After each row, still inside the outer "repeat": "repeat 5 times" "move back", then "turn right", "move forward" and "turn left".

steps.goal: Build a solid cube 3 blocks long, 3 wide and 3 tall. How many blocks does it take?
steps.not_yet: Not yet: build a solid cube, 3 × 3 × 3, with no holes.
hints: A cube is 3 floors stacked on top of each other: put your floor inside a third loop. Volume = 3 × 3 × 3 = 27 blocks.
Start every layer by going up one block. After a layer, go back to its first row: turn left, move forward 3 blocks, turn right.
block_hints: A cube is 3 floors stacked on top of each other: put your floor inside a third "repeat". Volume = 3 × 3 × 3 = 27 blocks.
Start every layer with "move up". After a layer, go back to its first row: "turn left", "repeat 3 times" "move forward", "turn right".
